name: Lilo
notes: All 3 photos are printed prix-fixe tasting-menu cards, each headed simply 'Menu' with no prices (tasting menu format). The three cards are different seasonal iterations of the same multi-course tasting menu, not duplicates of each other, so all courses from all three are kept even where a course name (e.g. Scallop, Gougere, A5 Miyazaki Wagyu) repeats with different ingredients. Photo 3's first course is cropped off the top of the frame and was dropped.
